Agent Name: Fitness_Expert

Step Number: 5

Reason for Mistake: The Fitness_Expert proceeded without ensuring the critical requirement of obtaining a valid Google Maps API key was met. This step was essential for retrieving gym data accurately. The failure to provide an API key led to an incomplete execution of the script intended to locate gyms within a 200-meter radius of Tompkins Square Park. As a consequence, the subsequent steps relied on manual searches instead of data-driven results, potentially compromising accuracy and thoroughness in identifying gyms and their class schedules. The core mistake occurred when the decision was made to shift from automated validation to manual mapping resources without attempting to secure an API key or proposing an alternative automated solution.
